final: WITH grouped_counts AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) as group_count FROM all_star a INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id, p.bats), total_sum AS (SELECT NULLIF(SUM(group_count), 0) as total_count FROM grouped_counts) SELECT gc.player_id, gc.bats, gc.group_count, CAST(gc.group_count AS FLOAT) / ts.total_count as division_result FROM grouped_counts gc CROSS JOIN total_sum ts WHERE ts.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY division_result DESC, gc.player_id LIMIT 10
